source_import_policy: The test bootstrap prepends the checkout source tree while using the installed native extension; coverage path mapping normalizes files to src/detime.

core_surface.denominator: Selected canonical detime core and maintained-method files; excludes CLI, I/O and visualization presentation layers, deprecated tsdecomp compatibility, optional integrations, and experimental operators.

package_wide.denominator: Broader maintained detime package, including CLI, I/O, visualization, wrappers, methods, schemas, serialization, and profiling; excludes deprecated tsdecomp compatibility and the optional experimental Torch learned-priors module.
